round2_outcome: No prospective foresight superiority established. Six candidates and known-method probes inform a cross-round researcher-agent synthesis.
selection: Confidential pre-emergency reserve-pool feasibility: an application hypothesis using established MPC; not one of the four raw search completion winners.
attribution: The ordinary first round supplied the utility reserve need. The expert second round sharpened the meaning/representation boundary. Root combined these with private computation after independent prior-art checks. Neither search arm alone receives credit for the selected construction.
controls: Two U and two E actual hosted completions, matched information and query caps within each round. Adaptive shared feedback separates rounds. Exact tokens, wall budget realization and billed model costs unexposed; no human trial.
claim_ceiling: Bounded discovery record and constructed application, not a world-first finding, population-level novelty estimate or numerical Operational Alpha.
